name: signbridge
description: Chrome extension that turns video subtitles and tab audio into real-time 3D Chinese Sign Language with local Whisper.

scripts.format: prettier --write src/ scripts/*.mjs tools/editor-full-entry.js tools/pose-editor.html tools/record-mode.html tests/ eslint.config.mjs package.json
scripts.test: npm run build --silent && npm run test:js
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test:js && npm run test:python && npx prettier --check src/ scripts/*.mjs tools/editor-full-entry.js tools/pose-editor.html tools/record-mode.html tests/ eslint.config.mjs package.json
